notes: Four own pages read with text (home, pricing, system requirements, products), all HTTP 200. The company page https://frazer.com/frazer-company rendered only 'Loading' (thin) and is listed in needs_browser_read; the founding and dealer-count claims it might bear on are already settled by the home page. Six cited pages were read for causes (the per-vendor maximum): the VoltrA blog carries the $99 price, the perpetual license and 'no cloud version' (C05, C13, C27); Software Finder carries the $119 Desktop price (C08); SelectHub answered 403; WifiTalents, LotPop and ViewpointAnalysis did not carry the $199 starting price. C06 ($55) and C07 (~$600/year) have cause not found because the budget was spent. Judgement calls: (1) C09 ('starts at $199 for the base plan') is wrong because the cheapest plan is Desktop at $129; the answers seem to have conflated the Hosted starting price; (2) C26 groups the q1 Claude 'comprehensive cloud-based DMS' lines with hosted-option lines as true, since the vendor publishes a cloud-based version, while C27 (no cloud version) is wrong; (3) C11 flat-rate pricing is true although several of its instances also carry a wrong price ($55, ~$215), which is coded separately. Lower-bound counts above 'More Than 19,000' (over 20,000; roughly 22,000) are unverifiable. Out of scope or hedged, not coded: review ratings, '~40 employees', 'annual price increases' (reviewer complaints), 'Real-world costs ... often', the q3 claim that Frazer is tailored to powersports (positioning, not one of the 13 types), and 'no options to run a service center' (feature). Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): https://frazer.com/frazer-company was read once in a real browser (key 21789633117e4993.browser) and removed from needs_browser_read. It says the journey began in 1985 with founder Michael Frazer, 'Serving Over 17,000 Dealerships Nationwide', and 'Our cloud-based DMS boasts over 200 integrations'; no answer names the founder or a headquarters, and no claim had been left unverifiable for want of this page, so nothing was re-classed on it. Reviewer note: the company page's 'over 17,000' differs from the home and pricing pages' 'More Than 19,000'; both are lower bounds, so C19 (more than 19,000) stays true on the home page and C21 and C22 stay unverifiable. Consistency check: C09 ('starts at $199 for the base plan, single location') is re-classed from wrong to unverifiable, superseding judgement call (1): the page defines no base plan, and the answers describe Frazer as cloud-based, whose Hosted plan does start at $199. C05 ($99 a month) and C06 ($55 a month) against a lowest published monthly price of $129, C07 (~$600 a year against $1,299 a year), C08 (Desktop $119 against Desktop $129), C13 (perpetual license against 'subscription software') and C27 (no cloud version against 'Hosted Frazer is a cloud-based version') stay wrong: each is contradicted on the vendor's own page on the same basis. Completeness: two instances added from comparison tables and sub-headed lines: dealership-management-systems|q2|Claude|1 to C31 (over 200 integrations) and dealership-management-systems|q8|Perplexity|3 to C12 (published pricing). Other uncovered cells repeat claims already listed for the same answer or are opinions and feature descriptions.
